text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see, that makes sense—you want to give a 
present to Ikuno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup. Turbo, Nature, and I formed the 
"Ikuno Takes Care of Us Alliance" to give 
her a proper thank you~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Though, even with the three of us 
brainstorming, we haven't exactly come up 
with a brilliant idea...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, I'm sure a great idea will come 
to you! Would you mind if I lent a hand as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Let's combine our efforts and prepare the 
best present ever!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, strategy meeting time! Good to 
have ya, Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking, a present doesn't 
necessarily have to be a physical "thing," 
right? For example, an invitation to an 
amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that makes sense! Then how about, how 
about, we make a surprise movie! I wanna 
make one!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The genre will be fantasy! Nature should 
be a wizard! And Machitan will be an 
appraiser!

text_block_list.name: Nature & Machitan
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, a wizard!? Ooh! I'll 
give it my all with a mun~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Setting that aside, I'd still like to 
give a physical gift. How about an effect 
where a real present jumps out from inside 
the video?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That sounds super hype! Let's do 
it, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is getting exciting! Let's keep 
bouncing ideas off each other!

One day, I spotted a group of horse girls 
gathered in a corner of the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. So there is a video you wish to 
show me. Most intriguing. I would be glad 
to view it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
She's definitely gonna be surprised! Look, 
look, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The time has come—everyone, combine your 
powers and transmute!

text_block_list.name: Machitan & Nature
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! O-Ohhh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! Let's cast magic on this 
ore that Machi-chan gathered!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Uhhh... Nice Nice Revolution~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And now, forge it into a horseshoe with 
this rainbow hammer— Turbo-chan, take it 
away!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Releasing the holy sword! 
Daaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay, the magic horseshoe is complete! I 
wonder if Ikuno will like it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now, Ikuno the Healer! Let's defeat the 
Demon King together with this magical 
horseshoe~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding, it's a present from all 
of us! Though it's really just an ordinary 
horseshoe, ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I am truly at a loss for words. Not 
just for the horseshoe, but for such 
wonderful footage as well.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, it was definitely worth working hard 
together. And huge thanks to Laurel-san 
for helping out too, truly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my gratitude as well. 
Thank you for such a lovely gift, 
Laurel-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was really nothing! All I did was 
offer some advice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The reason you were able to make 
Ikuno-chan happy was because all of you 
joined forces together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't have worked if even one person 
was missing. ...I'm so glad you could give 
her such a wonderful gift.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we secretly made a cake too! The 
three of us did our best decorating it, 
you know? Please, let's all eat it 
together later!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you even made a cake together...! 
Combining everyone's strength really is 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean Turbo and the others are 
super awesome?! We're the strongest, the 
absolute strongest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right♪ Bringing everyone's 
power together really is incredible.
